component.name: Lampstand
component.summary: Local LAMP stack installer and virtual host manager

description.p: Lampstand turns a fresh Ubuntu machine into a local LAMP development server, then gives you a GUI to manage it.

The setup wizard installs Apache, PHP (with the extensions WordPress, Drupal and Laravel need), Node.js with a system-wide NVM, MySQL and phpMyAdmin — all from Ubuntu's official apt repositories, skipping anything already installed.

ul.li: Map any project folder to a local domain as an Apache virtual host
Grant system users write access to the web root via the www-data group
Audit and fix ownership and permissions under /var/www/html
Start, stop and restart Apache and MySQL, and control whether they start on boot
